column1: # The 16 Brucella reference genomes of the MASH sketch (references.msh), as vSNP assembled it.
# reference: the sketch ID, which is the file name the sketch was built from.
# code: the vSNP species code, written to the "species" column of the legacy xlsx report.
# accessions: the NCBI nucleotide accessions of the reference, chromosome 1 first. Empty for the two
# references vSNP distributes under its own name rather than as an accession.
